_about: Operator-owned list prices in USD per million tokens, used to ESTIMATE spend from the [usage] log lines. Edit when a provider changes prices: add a new entry with its validFrom date and keep the old one. A usage day older than every validFrom is priced with the earliest entry (an estimate at that rate, not the rate in force then). The peak window is DeepSeek's; the claude entries carry the same figure for peak and offPeak.

peak.note: Peak is 01:00-04:00 and 06:00-10:00 UTC, Monday to Friday, excluding Chinese public holidays. Off-peak is half the peak rate. Holidays are not modelled, so those days are estimated at the peak rate: an upper bound.

prices.source: Anthropic list price from the claude-api skill table, cached 2026-10-06. Check the Anthropic pricing page before relying on it.
prices.note: The rate for prompts up to 100K tokens. Longer prompts are 0.50 in / 2.50 out; the pipeline's prompts are far below 100K. Cache reads are 0.1x input. Cache writes are not used.
